scope: PHASE 09 — Frontend Engineering audit (15 commanded areas)
verified_by: code read of all 14 view/shared/context files + dev chunk inspection + API contract checks

findings.finding: Router = 60-line if/else + duplicated RouterWithStaffDefault special-case; no declarative route map, no permission gate, no 404 view, role defaults implicit
All 20+ views eagerly imported (recharts AdminViews2 + DsShowcase in initial bundle); no code splitting

CLIENT BUNDLE CONTAMINATION: AppShell(client) → lib/constants → workflow/engine → lib/db → @prisma/client. Prisma browser stub verified in .next/dev/static chunks (bundle bloat + server code in browser graph)
~18 data loads swallow errors via .catch(() => {}) → permanent skeleton or silent failure (violates SP-5 actionable error)
8 list views lack loading init state (Orders/Tickets/Payments/Shipments/Users/Diseases/Products/price-history) → flash-of-empty before fetch (violates SP-1/SP-7 loading→error→empty→content)
No shared data-fetch layer: one-off useEffect+useState per view; no dedup/cache/retry/invalidation
api() throws generic Error(data.error) — envelope code/requestId/zod field errors (ED-94) discarded; no typed ApiError
logoutUser() duplicates CSRF/fetch logic outside the API client
No debounce on search inputs (Shop/Queue/Users) → request per keystroke + out-of-order response race
login/register responses lack permissions → context permissions stay [] for entire session (until reload /me); permission-aware UI impossible
No can()/usePermission helper; navigation not permission-gated (patient can render admin view state); nav hardcoded role branches ×6 — drift risk vs 31-permission RBAC matrix (UX-07)
CaseWorkspace action visibility uses hardcoded role string arrays ×5 instead of deriving from CASE_MACHINE transitions (single source)
Zero client validation with zod/react-hook-form (both installed): phone regex, password policy, min-lengths surface as raw 422 server toasts; no field-level errors; no aria-invalid
USER_DECLINE submits hardcoded reason 'عدم تمایل به ادامه' — no user input; no dirty-guard on any form (SP-5)
CartPage computes total = subtotal + HARDCODED 50000 shipping client-side; server getCart returns subtotal only → UI total can diverge from orderService computeTotals (domain policy not exposed)
NewCase description min 10 chars enforced client-only (server requiredText min 1) — rule must be mirrored server-side
PaymentsVerifyPage custom fixed-inset modal: no role=dialog, no focus trap, no Escape (violates §26 modal spec); should use shadcn Dialog
Questionnaire options lack aria-pressed; most form Labels lack htmlFor/id pairing; icon-only buttons have non-localized aria-labels ('Theme','Open menu'); no skip-to-content link

lang2() reads document.documentElement.lang at render time (SSR-unsafe, non-reactive) in PatientViews; ProgressTrack always Persian; raw enum values (ticket category, priority, followup status) untranslated; ~35 hardcoded strings
img without width/height (CLS) and loading=lazy; no React.memo on list rows
document.getElementById('proforma-ship-cost') imperative DOM read in CaseWorkspace (uncontrolled input anti-pattern)
RBAC matrix view truncated to 18 of 31 permissions (.slice(0,18)); leftover empty JSX expressions { } ×5 files
No UI E2E suite for Critical User Journeys (UJ-1..UJ-6); only API-level integration test exists
Unknown view.page silently falls to role default (no not-found state); staff dashboard special-case duplicated

server_side_gaps.fix: authService login/register must return permissions (session start contract for permission-aware UI)
getCart must return shippingCost + total via domain computeTotals (kill client-side pricing F15)
caseCreateSchema description min(10) — mirror client rule server-side (F16)

plan: A. server: login/register permissions + cart server totals + description min
B. infra: workflow/pure.ts (F03) + api-client (ApiError ED-94) + useApiQuery + useDebounced + forms.ts zod mirror + form field components
C. routing: declarative route map + permission gate + 403/404 views + next/dynamic lazy views + nav from single source
D. context: permissions on login, can(), logout via client
E. views: migrate to useApiQuery/PageState, zod forms, machine-derived actions, Dialog receipt viewer, a11y/i18n fixes
F. gates: frontend-audit.mjs (pattern gate) + ui-audit + lint
G. E2E: agent-browser driven critical journeys suite
H. docs: FRONTEND.md + ED registry + validators + commit
